note: Bighorn NF campground at the confluence of Prune Creek and the South Tongue River, on US-14 about 23 miles west of Dayton, run by a concessionaire. The west loop sits along both creeks; the east loop is in the pines. --Claude
summary: FS page and rec.gov current. 20 sites (not 21: no 013), 4 first-come, $20.50 on rec.gov ($23 on FS), 14-day limit, Jun 11 - Sep 20 2027. Waterfront lead riverfront -> creekside: both streams are ~7-17 m wide; sites 005-010 sit ~10-30 m from them. Phone empty -> 307-431-7446.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD riverfront -> creekside: on Esri imagery Prune Creek (W side) is ~7-12 m wide and the South Tongue (S side, below the confluence) ~9-17 m - both under 30 m, so the value is creekside, not riverfront. Sites at the water, all sold by the night (reservable): 006 (44.76990,-107.47062, ~17 m), 007 (44.76957,-107.47064, ~11 m), 008 (44.76942,-107.47053, ~22 m), 009 (44.76935,-107.47039, ~33 m) along Prune Creek with scattered conifers between, not a continuous screen; 010 (44.76903,-107.46995, ~20 m over open meadow) on the South Tongue; 005 (44.77005,-107.47052, ~27 m, more trees). Rec.gov tags 005-010 'Riverfront'. The east loop (014-021) is in pines with no water. Stored value is not --AWH; results don't change waterfront.
FEES: FS page says 'Single Site: $23 per night'; recreation.gov sells $20.50 (2026-2028 tables) - wrote rec.gov's figure.
